strings.이제 걱정하지 않으셔도 돼요. %s 님이 프뉴마에서 돌아오신 순간부터,: You needn't worry now. Ever since you returned from Pneuma, %s, even Lady Gaia's concern for Lady Iris... Everything is all right now.
strings.프뉴마의 기운이 나쁜 건 아니지만, 그걸 바로 느낀 존재들에게 어떤 영향: Pneuma's energy isn't evil, but we didn't know how it might affect beings directly exposed to it.
I'm glad. Then I'll be going...
strings.뭔가 하실 말씀이 있으셔서 제게 온 게 아니신가요?: Didn't you come because you had something to say?
I just wanted to see how you were doing.
This time, I have something to tell you.
There's something you brought back from Pneuma, Adventurer.
Something that should have remained in Pneuma seems to have come here with you, %s.
strings.저는 들고 온 기억이 없어요. 그런 게 있다면 이리스가 이야기해줬을 텐데: I don't remember bringing anything. Iris would have told me if I had...
strings.프뉴마는 고대신의 기운이 남아있는 곳…. 이리스 님이 느끼지 못하셨을 수: Pneuma retains the ancient gods' energy... Lady Iris may not have sensed it. She will know now.
strings.그 물건이 신을 부정하는 자들에게 들어가면 악용될 수 있어요. 그래서 회: If it falls into the hands of those who reject the gods, it could be misused. Would you retrieve it for me?
If I brought it here, I'll find it.
It should be safe with me. I can keep its power from affecting this place.
strings.그래서 찾아야 할 것은 뭔가요?: What exactly am I looking for?
Hourglasses... Hourglasses of different colors, each holding different emotions.
strings.프뉴마에서 보신 모래시계와는 달라요. 어째서 그게 온지는 잘 모르겠지만…: They're different from the hourglasses you saw in Pneuma. I don't know why they came... But please retrieve them. It would take me a long time to find them.
strings.아마도 강한 힘이 머물렀던 지역으로 흘러갔겠죠…. 일단 먼저 하나를 찾아: They likely drifted toward places where great power lingered... Find the first, and it should help you find the next.
I sense the feeling of purification...
The purple sand was sparkling, so I found it easily.
strings.일반적인 물건은 아니죠?: It isn't an ordinary object, is it?
strings.정제되지 않는 프뉴마의 기운…. 비록 나쁜 물건은 아니지만, 이곳과는 어: Unrefined energy from Pneuma... It isn't evil, but it does not belong here.
strings.담겨 있던 보라색 모래에는 몸과 마음이 깨끗해지기를 바라는 정화의 감정이: The purple sand holds the feeling of purification, the wish for a clean body and mind.
A feeling the ancient gods wished for the world.
strings.(미뉴에트가 눈을 감자 모래시계에 있던 보라색 모래가 흔들리더니 조금씩: (As Minuet closes her eyes, the purple sand stirs inside the hourglass, then gradually disappears.)
strings.가이아 님께서도 이 모래시계가 이렇게 쓰이길 바라시겠죠. 이리스 님도 이: Lady Gaia would wish this hourglass to be used this way. Lady Iris will feel these emotions too...
strings.이제 남은 건 어디서 찾아야 하죠?: Where should I look for the others?
strings.그게 저도…. 잘 모르겠어요!: That... I don't really know either!
I could sense this one because it was nearby.
But I can't leave Adrica, so...
We hardly have any clues. Where should I go...?
Then I'll tell you about the feelings within the hourglasses...
strings.열정과 사랑, 번영과 활력, 행복, 희망과 평화, 안정과 조화, 그리고: Passion and love, prosperity and vitality, happiness, hope and peace, stability and harmony, and care for another.
Look for places suited to those six remaining feelings...
strings.너무 막연한 것 같지만…. 안정과 조화라면 떠오르는 존재가 있어요. 하르: It's a little vague... But stability and harmony bring someone to mind. Harmonia...
strings.거기 있는 모래시계는 저에게 가져오실 필요 없어요. 하르모니아는 하르모니: You needn't bring that hourglass back to me. Harmonia will deal with it in her own way.
...Lady Gaia will guide you. Don't worry too much.
strings.(미뉴에트가 살며시 미소를 짓는다. 여전히 무표정 같아 보이지만, 왠지: (Minuet gives a faint smile. Her face still seems almost expressionless, yet you sense a quiet joy.)
Then I'll go and look there.
strings.(하르모니아가 %s의 등장에 살짝 놀라는 표정을 짓는다.): (Harmonia looks a little startled at %s's arrival.)
strings.안녕하세요, 하르모니아. 그런데 왜 그렇게 놀라요?: Hello, Harmonia. Why are you so surprised?
It's been a while. I'm sorry to greet you with such a startled look.
strings.분명 모험가님인데, 다른 곳의 기운이 느껴져서요. 혹시 여기 말고 정령들: You're clearly the adventurer, but I sense energy from somewhere else. Somewhere full of spirits, apart from here...
Oh, so that's why. Here's what happened...
strings.아…. 프뉴마에 다녀오셔서 그랬군요. 안 그래도 이곳의 느낌이 이상했거든: Ah... You've been to Pneuma. That explains it. Something has felt strange here.
strings.이곳의 정령들이 다른 곳으로 갈 준비를 하고 있다가 동요했는데, 이런 이: The spirits were preparing to move elsewhere when they became unsettled. So that was why.
strings.(하르모니아가 목걸이를 쥐고 있다가 조용히 하늘을 바라본다.): (Holding her necklace, Harmonia quietly looks at the sky.)
An hourglass from there seems to have fallen somewhere with a cold energy.
strings.그게 있다면 고대신들이 조화와 안정을 원하는 그 감정이 그대로 이리스 님: With it, the ancient gods' wishes for harmony and stability can be conveyed directly to Lady Iris.
It's not an object a spirit can handle carelessly. Please bring it to me, Adventurer.
I found it without much trouble.
strings.먼저 모래시계를 주시겠어요?: May I have the hourglass first?
strings.(하르모니아가 목걸이를 들고 있던 오른손을 뻗자 %s의 손에 있던 모래시: (Harmonia extends the right hand holding her necklace. The hourglass slowly rises from %s's hand.)
strings.(하르모니아의 손짓에 따라 모래시계의 유리에 금이 가고, 그 틈으로 파란: (At Harmonia's gesture, the glass cracks. Blue sand spills through the fissures and scatters away.)
These are the feelings of stability and harmony wished for in Pneuma...
The gods must have looked upon spirits and living beings with such feelings.
strings.아, 그런데 정령들이 다른 곳으로 간다는 이야기를 했잖아요. 심상세계에: Oh, you mentioned that the spirits are moving elsewhere. Is something happening to the Inner World?
strings.무슨 큰일이 있는 건 아니에요. 이제 이리스 님의 심상세계는 조금씩 작아: Nothing serious. Lady Iris' Inner World will gradually become smaller now...
Lady Iris has taken her place as God of the Astral Realm, so there is less reason to maintain this place.
strings.저와 기아스는 이곳에 있는 정령들을 다른 곳으로 보내는 중이에요. 이곳이: Geis and I are sending the spirits here to other places. As this place gradually disappears, we will have to leave too.
strings.글쎄요…. 각자 자신을 필요로 하는 곳이 있다면 자연스레 그 장소로 가게: Who can say...? Each will naturally be drawn to a place where they are needed.
I see. Where should I look for the remaining hourglasses...?
strings.모래시계가 아드리카와 이리스 님의 심상세계로 흘러온 건 정령의 기운을 따: The hourglasses that drifted into Adrica and Lady Iris' Inner World seem to have followed the spirits' energy.
strings.…아무래도 남은 건 밖으로 나가서 찾아야 해요. 알고 계신 정령들의 도움: ...You'll have to go outside to find the rest. Try asking the spirits you know for help.
Lord Lapidem outside should be able to help you.
It's been a while. I should go visit him. See you later, Harmonia.
Yes. I'll see you somewhere new. I must go help the other spirits.
strings.(하르모니아가 인사를 하고 천천히 불타는 도시 방향으로 걸어간다.): (Harmonia says goodbye and slowly walks toward the Burning City.)
strings.원래 여기 말고 다른 곳에 있었다고 했으니 거기로 가는 거겠지?: She said she used to live elsewhere. I suppose she'll go back there.
All right, straight to Monster Tree Mountain.
Such warm weather. Makes a fellow sleepy.
strings.아차, 잠이 들면 안 되니께 정신 바짝 차려야혀. 전에도 잠깐 잠들었다가: Oops, can't fall asleep. Must keep my wits about me. Last time I nodded off, Arborum appeared. Terrible business.
strings.안녕하세요, 라피뎀. 잘 지내셨어요?: Hello, Lapidem. Have you been well?
Well enough. I've heard plenty about you.
I'm sorry I haven't visited lately.
strings.괜찮여. 괜찮여. 바쁘면 그럴 수 있재. 신뢰를 잔뜩 받고 나서 코빼기도: No trouble, no trouble. You're busy. After earning all that trust and never showing your face, I nearly forgot what you looked like.
Only joking. It's the goddess' work, after all.
strings.자네, 프뉴마에 다녀온겨? 안 그려도 하르모니아가 가르친 정령들이 돌아다: Have you been to Pneuma? Harmonia's students have been traveling about, and I heard the spirits mention it.
Yes. I had something to discuss with Lady Gaia.
strings.(라피뎀에게 프뉴마에 다녀왔다는 이야기를 전한다.): (You tell Lapidem about your visit to Pneuma.)
strings.위버 갸가 거기 있었구만. 가이아 님께서 거두셨다는 이야기를 듣긴 했는데: So the Weaver was there. I'd heard Lady Gaia took the child in.
strings.자네가 돌아오면서 가지고 온 모래시계가 어디 있는지 알고 싶은겨?: You want to know where the hourglasses you brought back have gone?
Yes. I'd like to draw on your wisdom, Lapidem.
strings.지혜는 무슨. 좀 오래 산 거밖에 안되는구만. 어디보자, 남은 게 뭐가: Wisdom? I've simply lived a bit longer. Let's see. What's left...?
strings.번영과 활력이면 인간들이 말하는 돈인겨?: Prosperity and vitality. Does that mean what humans call money?
strings.그러면 답이 나왔구만. 이 근방에 돈에 환장하는 아들 있재? 만날 고양이: Then there's your answer. You know the youngsters around here who are mad about money? Always running around catching cats.
strings.그 파르밀라…라는 아이 말여. 자주 와서 정령인지도 모르고 말여. 기도를: That girl, Parmila. She comes here often, never realizing I'm a spirit, and prays. 'Dear spirit, look after our company and let us earn loads of money, please!'
strings.아까도 왔다 갔구만. 그러고 내 앞에 있는 꽃을 한 송이씩 가져가는데,: She came by just now, too. Always takes a flower from in front of me when she leaves. Ah!
strings.뭔지 몰라도 기분이 묘했는데, 그게 모래시계였나벼. 아마도 파르밀라 갸가: Something felt odd, though I couldn't place it. Must have been the hourglass. It was probably among the flowers Parmila took.
strings.돈을 바라는 마음이 얼매나 강하면 그 물건이 인간에게 가는겨…, 갸도 보: How badly must she want money for that object to go to a human...? She's quite something.
strings.%s, 뭐 혀. 어여 가야지. 만에 하나라도 그 꽃이 사악한 흔적이 남아: What are you waiting for, %s? Get going. If that flower reaches a place where traces of evil linger, we'll have trouble.
strings.얼른 용병단 갸한테 물어 찾어! 찾는 대로 내게 가져와야 혀. 알았재?: Hurry, ask the mercenary girl and find it! Bring it straight to me when you do. Understood?
Captain, I've mostly finished the work you assigned.
Then shall we get going? We can leave things here to Arcane for a while.
strings.아니. 그 전에 할 일이 있어. 의회의 감시에서 칼로네가 벗어나야 하니까: No. There's something to do first. We need to get you out from under the council's watch, Callone.
strings.지금 무슨 생각해? 지나가는 고양이, 칼로네?: What are you thinking about, Callone? Our little cat passing through?
strings.그때는 황녀님을 만나 놀라서 말이 헛나온 건데, 언제까지 그걸로 놀릴 생: I was startled by meeting the princess and said the wrong thing. How long are you going to tease me about it?
Hello, both of you. It's been a while.
strings.저야 뭐…. 여기는 별일 없었죠?: Oh, you know... Nothing unusual here?
They say incidents follow wherever %s goes.
The events we hear about alone are enough to draw the empire's attention.
I'm not some detective. It's not that bad.
A joke. Just a joke. You are looking for something, though, right? You keep glancing around.
strings.혹시 괴물나무 산에서 가져온 꽃 어디다 뒀어요?: Where did you put the flower you brought from Monster Tree Mountain?
strings.꽃? 아, 그거? 예뻐보여서 조심스레 가져왔는데, 안 되는 거야?: A flower? Oh, that one? It looked pretty, so I brought it back carefully. Was I not supposed to?
It's not that. I need it.
strings.그래? 돈 많이 벌게 해달라고 빌고 가져온 건데, 어쩔 수 없지. 그거: Really? I prayed for lots of money before taking it, but I suppose it can't be helped. I left it in the middle of the Belkia Kingdom Army Cemetery.
strings.급한가 보다. 저렇게 빨리 뛰어갈 일인 건가?: Must be urgent. Does it really call for running that fast?
strings.아무래도 우리와는 다른 부류의 사람이니 그렇겠죠. 신과 직접적으로 엮여: We belong to different worlds, after all. Directly involved with the gods...
Oh, what's wrong with us? Have a little confidence.
strings.이제 의회에서 주목하는, 그러니까 프레이오스에 숨어있는 사람들을 찾을 거: Now we'll track down the people the council is watching—the ones hiding in Freios. That should reveal what the Magic Bureau is concealing.
Yes. There's someone I need to meet sooner or later anyway.
strings.그럴 수도 있고, 마…. 아차, 나중에 이야기해줄게. 일단 짐부터 챙길까: Perhaps. Or a wi... Oops. I'll tell you later. Let's pack first.
strings.(전사들의 쉼터에 보이는 묘비의 수만큼 엄청나게 많은 꽃들 사이로 주황색: (Orange light spills from among the vast number of flowers, as numerous as the headstones in the Warriors' Resting Place.)
Ah, here it is! The orange hourglass...
strings.(모래시계가 나타난 건 반갑지만, 왜 여기서 모습을 드러낸 거지?): (I'm glad it appeared, but why did it reveal itself here?)
Thinking won't give me an answer. Let's just return to Monster Tree Mountain.
strings.하늘을 보니께 심상치 않구만. 내 지금까지 봤던 하늘하고는 다르네…. 어: That sky looks unusual. Different from any I've seen before... Oh, you're back?
strings.네, 바로 찾아서 들고 왔어요. 그런데 혼잣말로 뭘 말씀하신 거예요?: Yes. I found it and brought it straight here. What were you saying to yourself?
strings.기분이 뭔가 이상혀서 말이여…. 숨어있던 정령들이 많이 튀어나와서 그런: Something feels strange... Maybe because so many spirits have come out of hiding, but...
strings.(이건 아가슈라를 만났을 때의 그런 기분도 아녀….): (This isn't like the feeling of meeting an Agasura, either...)
strings.어라, 꽃에 스며들어간 줄 알았던 모래시계를 그대로 들고 왔네? 뭐, 됐: Oh? You've brought the hourglass intact? I thought it had seeped into the flower. Never mind. Put it in front of me. It'll disappear on its own.
strings.(라피뎀의 말대로 모래시계를 내려놓고 기다리자 주위에 있던 꽃들이 피고: (You set down the hourglass as Lapidem instructed. As you wait, the surrounding flowers bloom and fade over and over.)
Oh, it vanished without a trace.
strings.그런데 모래시계 말여. 스스로 번영과 활력의 기운을 줄 대상을 찾은 건지: But that hourglass... I can't tell whether it sought out something to receive its prosperity and vitality, or someone changed it.
strings.만약 그 힘이 묘로 들어갔다고 생각혀봐. 뼈가 얼마 안남은 벨키아 군사지: Imagine if that power had entered a grave. There may be little left of those Belkia soldiers but bones, but having them roam Mirgandia would be a nuisance.
Whew. Retrieving them isn't difficult, but there are quite a few.
Can't be helped. It's your job now...
strings.그런데 이제 남은 건 어디서 찾죠?: Where should I look for the rest?
Hmm... Try another spirit you know.
strings.남은 건 열정과 사랑, 행복, 희망과 평화, 그리고 누군가를 위하는 마음: Passion and love, happiness, hope and peace, and care for another. Four left, right?
Yes. The only other spirit I can reach right away is Narin.
strings.아, 나린. 나린…! 갸는 물과 얼음의 정령왕이재? 그 아이가 지금 자넬: Ah, Narin. Narin! The Spirit King of Water and Ice, yes? She'll be waiting for you. Go on, then.
How do you know Narin will be waiting for me?
strings.내는 정령이잖여. 자넨 사람이고. 안 그려? 정령은 정령끼리 통하는 게: I'm a spirit, and you're human, aren't you? Spirits have our own ways of understanding one another.
I'll go right away. And I'm sorry. I'll visit more often.
Still taking my little remark to heart? Forget it. It's all right. See you later.
strings.(나린이 기다리고 있다면 거기는 어떤 모래시계가 있는 거지…? 일단 가볼: (If Narin is waiting, which hourglass is there...? I'd better go.)
I have been waiting for you.
So you knew I was coming.
strings.정령들이 동요해서 제 부족한 능력이지만 알아봤지요. 이 근처에서 이 세계: The spirits were unsettled, so I investigated with what little ability I possess. I learned that an object from another world had fallen nearby.
strings.그래도 저와 비슷한 기운의 것이고, 가이아 님의 손길이 느껴지기에 일단: Its energy resembled mine, and I sensed Lady Gaia's touch, so I was watching it for the time being.
strings.마침 정령 어르신이라는 분이 멀리서 말씀을 보내주신 덕에 모험가님을 기다: Then an elder spirit sent word from afar. That is why I awaited you, Adventurer.
strings.모험가님, 다녀오신 곳에 대해서 설명을 해주실 수 있으신지요?: Would you tell me about the place you visited?
strings.(나린에게 프뉴마에 다녀온 이야기를 건넨다.): (You tell Narin about your visit to Pneuma.)
It fills me with a strange longing...
strings.(이야기를 이어가던 나린의 눈가에 눈물이 조금씩 맺히더니 그대로 떨어진다: (As Narin speaks, tears gather in her eyes and fall. They become ice crystals, carried away on the wind.)
strings.송구합니다. 이렇게 하려고 한 게 아니온데…. 그저 누군가를 향한 위로의: Forgive me. I did not mean to... I simply felt someone's wish to offer comfort. Ah!
It seems to be outside the village. The object lies where great power once lingered...
strings.메아리의 샘이겠지요. 아마도 그 물건은 모험가님과 함께 이 세계로 왔기: Echo Spring, surely. Since the object entered this world with you, Adventurer, it will probably reveal itself only to you.
I'll find it and bring it straight back to you.
strings.(나린이 %s에게서 받은 모래시계를 빤히 바라본다.): (Narin gazes intently at the hourglass received from %s.)
strings.…이 안에서 감정이 요동치고 있사옵니다. 생명을 위한…. 아마도 자신보다: ...Emotions surge within it. For the sake of life... Perhaps the nature of a living being that puts others before itself.
They are connected to the feelings once held by the ancient gods.
If the power of this hourglass reaches the goddess, it will help her greatly.
strings.할 일을 하는 것뿐이지요. 송구합니다. 그러면 얼음도 단숨에 녹이도록 하: I am merely doing my duty. Pardon me. I shall deal with it as swiftly as melting ice in an instant.
strings.(나린이 두루마리를 펼치고 그 위에 남색 모래시계를 올려둔다.): (Narin opens her scroll and sets the indigo hourglass upon it.)
strings.(나린이 주문을 외우자 모래시계가 천천히 가루처럼 두루마리 안으로 스며든: (As Narin chants, the hourglass slowly seeps into the scroll like powder.)
I never get used to that spell, no matter how often I hear it.
You must hear it a thousand more times. Then you will grow accustomed to it.
strings.후후, 오늘은 이걸로 끝이옵니다. 이 감정이 여신님께도 많은 도움이 될: Hehe. That is all for today. I believe these feelings will be of great help to the goddess.
This scroll was bestowed by a god...
strings.고마워요, 나린. 정령님들 덕분에 많이 모았어요. 그런데 나머지는 어디서: Thank you, Narin. I've collected quite a few with the spirits' help. But I have no idea where to look for the rest.
strings.이리스 님께서도 어떻게 찾아야 할지 고민하고 계실 것이옵니다. 계속해서: Lady Iris must be considering how to find them as well. You will still need the spirits' help.
Which spirits perform which duties... I shall help you learn.
strings.(이리스도 많이 고민이겠지….): (Iris must have a lot to think about too...)
strings.너무 걱정하지 마시옵소서. 저와 이오도 여러 가지로 모래시계의 행방을 알: Do not worry too much. Io and I will look into the hourglasses' whereabouts in various ways. Please wait for word.
It is no trouble. Now, I have duties to attend to, so I shall take my leave.
strings.(감은 안 잡히지만, 일단 단서를 모아가는 수밖에….): (I don't have a clear lead, but all I can do is keep gathering clues...)
